notes.title: Update 2
notes.content: A small change in scripts. Now when opponents notice you, you have a chance to run away or freeze the enemy within 1 second.

notes.title: Update!
notes.content: Added extra level that will open after passing the first. In a new level you need to fight back from storming the zone. The goal of the level is to hold out for 4 minutes, you cannot allow penetration to the base.
